topic_ko: 동조 압력을 이용한 너지 — 사회 규범을 보여 주면 행동이 바뀌지만, 메시지를 잘못 설계하면 역효과가 난다

passage: Learn what everyone around you is doing and you will probably do it as well.
Even in doubt, few of us enjoy standing outside a social norm, so we fall in line.
That instinct means simply pointing out the good choices of others can move people toward the right action.
A sign threatening a fine pushes; a sign reporting that other visitors carry their trash home nudges.
The choice remains with each person, yet the decision has been quietly shaped.
This method, however, does not always deliver what its designers expect.
When households were told how much energy their neighbors used, heavy users cut back but light users raised their consumption.
Only after a smiley face was added to the reports did that backward effect disappear.

theme.explanation_ko: 다른 사람의 행동을 알려 주는 것이 행동을 바꾸지만 메시지 설계가 잘못되면 역효과가 난다는 두 축이 글 전체를 이루므로 ③이 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ① 벌금은 너지와 대비되는 사례로 한 번 나올 뿐이다. ② 개인 정보 침해는 언급되지 않았다. ④ 동조 심리는 도입 근거일 뿐 원인 분석이 글의 목적이 아니다. ⑤ 구체적 절약 방법은 제시되지 않는다.

passage: People take their cues from one another more than they admit.
Told that others behave a certain way, we tend to assume it is the sensible thing to do.
Even when we are unsure, the pull of social norms keeps us from breaking ranks.
So highlighting the right decisions of others can quietly steer people toward those decisions.
But the same tool can misfire.
In one energy study, residents learned how their use compared with their neighbors' average.
Heavy users cut back as predicted, while light users, discovering they were below average, used more.
Adding a smiley face to the low users' reports canceled that unwanted result.
choices: 사회 규범을 활용한 너지는 강력하지만 메시지 설계에 따라 역효과가 날 수 있다.
에너지 절약은 개인의 의지보다 요금 제도에 더 크게 좌우된다.
사람들은 자신이 평균보다 낫다는 사실을 알면 언제나 더 노력한다.
표지판의 문구는 벌금 액수가 클수록 효과가 커진다.
이웃과의 비교 정보는 어떤 경우에도 제공하지 않는 것이 옳다.
gist.explanation_ko: 규범을 보여 주는 너지의 힘과 저사용 가구에서 나타난 역효과, 그리고 웃는 얼굴로 이를 바로잡은 사례가 모두 ①로 요약된다.
gist.distractor_ko: ② 요금 제도는 다루지 않는다. ③ 평균보다 낮은 가구는 오히려 사용량을 늘렸으므로 반대이다. ④ 벌금 액수의 크기를 비교한 서술은 없다. ⑤ 웃는 얼굴을 더하면 효과가 살아나므로 정보 제공 자체를 부정하지 않는다.

passage: Hearing what others do is often enough to change what we do.
We assume the crowd knows something, and we would rather not break a social norm.
So a message that reports the good behavior of others can guide people toward it.
"Carry your trash home or pay a fine" pushes; "Carry your trash home, as others do" nudges.
The person still decides, but the decision has been gently shaped.
The tactic can also work in reverse.
In a household energy study, low users learned they were below their neighbors' average and promptly used more.
Researchers fixed the problem by adding one small smiley face to the report.
choices: Why Fines Work Better Than Friendly Advice
The Crowd as a Guide, and Where It Misleads
Household Energy Bills Around the World
Social Media and the Rise of Peer Pressure
How to Design a Perfect Warning Sign

title.distractor_ko: ① 본문은 벌금보다 규범 제시를 너지로 옹호한다. ③ 세계 각국의 요금 비교는 없다. ④ 소셜 미디어는 등장하지 않는다. ⑤ 경고 표지 제작법이 글의 목적이 아니다.

passage: If you are told what other people do, you might do it too, because you think it is probably a good idea to do what they do.
Even when you are unsure, you would rather not disobey a social norm, so you go along.
Highlighting the right decisions of others can therefore lead one to do the right thing.
A sign that threatens a fine pushes people, while a sign that reports what others do nudges them.
The decision is theirs, but they have been nudged.
Still, the crowd can point the wrong way as easily as the right one.
Households using less energy than average raised their use once they learned where they stood.
A smiley face added to their reports neutralized that opposite effect.

So a message that reports the good behavior of others can steer people toward it.
A fine threatens; a report of what others do simply invites.

Households were shown how their energy use compared with the neighborhood average.

summary.summary_template: Information about what neighbors do can __(A)__ people toward better behavior, but without a supportive cue it may __(B)__ on those who are already doing well.
